newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Novartis completes Systemix tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Novartis completes Systemix tender offer.

text.p: Swiss pharmaceuticals group Novartis AG said it completed its tender offer for all the outstanding shares of Systemix Inc.

Based on a preliminary count, 4,711,319 Systemix common shares, or approximately 98.2 percent of the outstanding shares held by persons other than Novartis and its affiliates, were tendered as of the February 14 offer expiry, Novartis said.
Systemix shares not tendered into the offer will be cancelled and converted automatically into the right to receive $19.50 per share in cash, Novartis also said.
Systemix will merge with Novartis Biotech Holding Corp as soon as practicable, the company also said.

Systemix is a Palo Alto, California-based biotechnology company. It specialises in the development of therapies for major disorders of the blood and immune system based on the use of isolated, expanded and gene-modified human hematopoietic stem cells.
